spec.name: sprint35_qhour_taker_imbalance_liquid
spec.hypothesis: Strong taker buy/sell volume imbalance in the first quarter-hour after open predicts short-horizon continuation in liquid large-cap names, net of realistic costs at T1 fees.
spec.power_argument: Prior sprints (n=4180, t=-19.8) imply ~110bps per-trade std; at n>=300 trades, min detectable edge at t=2 is ~12.7bps, comfortably above T1 round-trip cost (~2-4bps) on liquid names — a real signal should be detectable even after costs.
